scenario_name: AutoGen-style Complaint Escalation Coordination — Case 3 for AgentCoordKG
description: Hand-authored scenario following AutoGen's real ConversableAgent/Message/GroupChatManager schema (confirmed via official AutoGen/AG2 documentation), NOT a live AutoGen run. Demonstrates AgentCoordKG's coverage of a message-native framework, where Message maps directly (unlike CrewAI's interpreted Task.context mapping) since AutoGen's architecture is natively message-passing.

_autogen_native_log._comment: Mimics a real AutoGen chat_history for a two-agent customer complaint escalation exchange, using AutoGen's actual field names. Not itself part of the RDF instance data.

_mapping_decision_tree_notes.ConversableAgent (name, system_message): Maps directly to ak:Agent -- no ontology change needed.
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.Message (content, role, name): Maps directly to ak:Message -- this is the cleanest Message mapping found across the frameworks studied so far, since AutoGen's architecture is natively message-passing (unlike CrewAI, where Message required an interpretive mapping via Task.context).
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.function_call (tool invocation within a: Maps to Task.usesTool (datatype property) once the invoked action is modeled as a Task -- consistent with the same tool-invocation-detail limitation noted in HarnessKG's AutoGen scenario (argument-level detail not separately representable).
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.GroupChatManager (coordinates turn order: Maps to dependsOn (Task -> Task) when each conversational turn is modeled as a Task in sequence -- a new, AutoGen-specific confirmation of the same Process/dependsOn correspondence found in CrewAI's scenario, reinforcing that turn-management/orchestration primitives across different frameworks consistently land on AgentCoordKG's coordination vocabulary rather than HarnessKG's.
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.'TERMINATE' final message signaling refu: Interpreted (not native to AutoGen) as triggering ak:Decision -- same treatment as HarnessKG's AutoGen scenario's use of 'TERMINATE', and consistent with the task-output-acceptance Decisions found in AgentCoordKG's illustrative and CrewAI scenarios.
_mapping_decision_tree_notes.Escalation agent flagging an authorizati: Interpreted (not native to AutoGen) as violatesConstraint -> Conflict -- AutoGen has no native constraint/conflict-detection primitive; this is our semantic interpretation of a review-feedback exchange, disclosed as such.

story_summary: A Frontline support agent logs a customer's damaged-shipment complaint, but the requested refund exceeds the agent's authorization limit -- a conflict. The case is escalated, and the Escalation agent authorizes a full refund.
